# Lord v. CDI / Blackstream - Evidence Map (Issue -> Fact -> Evidence)

*Auto-generated 2026-07-01 from `DOCUMENT_INDEX.xlsx` and `ISSUE_TAXONOMY_v2.md`.*

**Purpose.** A single cross-reference that runs each **legal issue** down to the **factual issues** it depends on and then to the **specific evidence files** in this repo that bear on each fact. Every link opens the file on GitHub.

**How to read it.** Direction = Supports / Adverse / Mixed. Weight = Direct / Strong / Corroborating / Background. Items marked *(provisional)* were tagged by filename inference and **need review** before you rely on them.

> This organizes the record; it is **not legal advice**. Issue codes match `ISSUE_TAXONOMY_v2.md` - don't renumber them.
